function wasmAnimType(flag): number

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/widgets/flag/anim.ts:100

Picks the wasm flag shader's personality — locale code → GPU_FLAG_ANIMS discriminant. The WebGL shader's four extra anim slots (GL/CA/NL/GA) have no dedicated wasm personality and map to the nearest regional effect.

Parameters

flag

FlagWebGL

Returns

number

Wasm anim discriminant for the widget's set_state call.
